info.name: PawPal Backend API
info.description: Postman collection for PawPal Backend API - Mobile and Dashboard endpoints

item.name: Mobile API
Auth

request.description: Register a new user account. confirmPassword must match password. Returns user data and JWT token.
Login with email and password. Returns user data and JWT token.
Refresh JWT token using the bearer token. Returns the same response shape as login.

item.description: Mobile API authentication endpoints for user registration and login

item.name: Reminders

request.description: Create a reminder for the authenticated user. petId is required and must reference a pet belonging to the user. Dates are parsed using app_time_zone_offset.
Get all reminders for the authenticated user. Supports optional search by title.
Get a single reminder by ID (only if it belongs to the authenticated user).
Update a reminder (only if it belongs to the authenticated user). All fields are optional. petId, if provided, must reference a pet belonging to the user.
Delete a reminder (only if it belongs to the authenticated user).

item.description: Reminder CRUD operations for mobile users. All endpoints require user authentication.

formdata.description: File to upload (field name must be: file)

query.description: Optional key prefix appended under users/<userId>/ (e.g. uploads/)

request.description:
Uploads a file to the Railway bucket and returns { bucket, key, signedUrl, publicUrl }.

item.description: Mobile file upload endpoints. All endpoints require user authentication.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Notification endpoints for mobile users. Requires a valid user JWT token.

query.description: Filter by read status: true or false
Filter by type: reminder, pet, system

request.description: Get all notifications for the authenticated user. Supports pagination and filtering by isRead and type.
Returns the count of unread notifications for the authenticated user. Response: { count: number }.
Marks a notification as read. The notification must belong to the authenticated user.
Marks all unread notifications as read for the authenticated user. Response: { updated: number }.

item.name: Dashboard API
Admin Auth

request.description: Admin login. Returns admin data and JWT token. Use this token for authenticated dashboard endpoints.

item.name: Admins

request.description: Get all admins with pagination and optional search. Requires admin authentication.
Get admin details by ID. Requires admin authentication.
Create a new admin. Requires admin authentication.
Update admin details. All fields are optional. Requires admin authentication.
Delete an admin. You cannot delete your own account. Requires admin authentication.

item.description: Admin CRUD operations. All endpoints require admin authentication.

item.name: Users

query.description: Search by name, email, or phone

request.description: Get all users with pagination and optional search. Requires admin authentication.
Get user details by ID. Requires admin authentication.
Create a new user. userRoleId is required (use GET /admin/api/user-roles to list roles). Requires admin authentication.
Update user details. userRoleId is required (other fields optional). Requires admin authentication.
Delete a user. Requires admin authentication.
Get users for dropdown (limited to id, name, email only). Requires admin authentication.

item.description: User CRUD operations. All endpoints require admin authentication.

item.name: Permissions

request.description: Returns all permissions (id, name, token, description) for assigning to user roles in the dashboard.

item.description: Permission catalog for RBAC. Requires admin authentication.

item.name: User Roles

request.description: List user roles with pagination and optional search. Each role includes its permissions.
Get a single user role with its permissions.
Create a user role. permissionIds must reference ids from GET /admin/api/permissions.
Update a user role. permissionIds replaces the full set when provided.
Delete a user role if no users are assigned to it. Cannot delete the Pet Owner role.

item.description: User role CRUD for mobile RBAC. Requires admin authentication.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Notification management endpoints for admins. Requires a valid admin JWT token.

request.description: Broadcasts a push notification to all users who have a registered device token. Blocked if ENABLE_SYSTEM_NOTIFICATIONS is disabled. No persistent DB record is created.
Sends a push notification to a single user identified by userId. Blocked if ENABLE_SYSTEM_NOTIFICATIONS is disabled. No persistent DB record is created.

item.name: Emails
item.description: Admin email broadcast (same pattern as Notifications). Requires admin JWT. Blocked if transactional emails are off (enable_transactional_emails) or mail env is not configured.

request.description: Sends the same HTML email to every user with a non-empty email. Returns { sent, skipped, failed }. Skipped = no email on profile.
Sends an HTML email to one user by userId. 400 if user has no email.

item.description: Dashboard API endpoints for admin dashboard access

item.name: Testing
Railway Bucket

formdata.description: File to upload (field name must be: file)

request.description:
Uploads a file to the Railway bucket (S3-compatible) and returns { bucket, key, signedUrl, publicUrl }.

Requires env: ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true and AWS_* bucket credentials on the server.

query.description: Signed URL TTL in seconds (min 60, max 7 days)

request.description:
Generates a signed GET URL for an existing object key.

Requires env: ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true and AWS_* bucket credentials on the server.

Lists bucket objects (optionally filtered by prefix).

Requires env: ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true and AWS_* bucket credentials on the server.

item.description: Testing endpoints for Railway bucket (S3-compatible) integration. Disabled unless ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true.

item.name: Mail

request.description:
Returns { provider, configured, transactionalEmailEnabled }. Does not send email.

- `transactionalEmailEnabled`: AppSetting token `enable_transactional_emails` (same pattern as enable_system_notifications).
- `configured`: MAIL_PROVIDER + provider env (e.g. RESEND_API_KEY + MAIL_FROM).

Requires env: ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true.

Sends email via the app mail layer (`sendEmail` / MAIL_PROVIDER). Required JSON: to (string or array), subject, html. Optional: text, from, replyTo, cc, bcc, idempotencyKey.

Requires env: ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true and provider config (e.g. MAIL_PROVIDER=resend, RESEND_API_KEY, MAIL_FROM). Set collection variable testMailTo to your inbox.

item.description: Testing endpoints for transactional mail (`/test/mail/*`). Disabled unless ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true.
Testing-only endpoints. All routes are disabled unless ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES=true is set in the server environment.

item.name: Development API
Audit Logs

query.description: Filter by HTTP verb: GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE
Status code range lower bound (inclusive). Combine with statusCodeMax for ranges like 400–499.
Filter by actor type: user | admin | anonymous
Sort field: createdAt | updatedAt | method | path | statusCode | actorType | actorId | durationMs (default: createdAt)

request.description:
Get paginated audit logs with optional filters.

All filter params are optional and can be combined freely.

Blocked automatically when NODE_ENV=production.

Get a single audit log entry by its UUID.

Blocked automatically when NODE_ENV=production.

item.description: Audit log inspection endpoints. Returns stored request/response data with actor, IP, and timing info.

item.name: Permissions sync

request.description: Upserts rows from src/manifest/permissions.manifest.ts (updates name/description by token; tokens never change). Set syncNewPermissionsToAllUserRoles to true and userRoleId to a numeric role id or the string "all" to attach newly created permissions to roles (userRoleId required when propagation is enabled).

item.description: Syncs the permission table from the manifest. Uses the same admin JWT as the dashboard.
Development-only endpoints. All routes return 404 when NODE_ENV=production. No additional env variable required.
